102 |     /// Validate that the configuration values are sensible.
103 |     pub fn validate(&self) -> Result<()> {
104 |         // Reject NaN and infinity first. The sign and ordering checks below
105 |         // compare with `<`/`>`, which are `false` for NaN and for a `+inf` on
106 |         // a field with no opposing bound, so a non-finite rate would otherwise
107 |         // slip through and silently disable throttling (a NaN rate makes the
108 |         // token bucket refill to full on every acquire) or, with a zero burst
109 |         // capacity, panic in `Duration::from_secs_f64`.
110 |         for (name, value) in [
111 |             ("initial_rate", self.initial_rate),
112 |             ("min_rate", self.min_rate),
113 |             ("max_rate", self.max_rate),
114 |             ("decrease_factor", self.decrease_factor),
115 |             ("additive_increment", self.additive_increment),
116 |             ("throttle_threshold", self.throttle_threshold),
117 |         ] {
118 |             if !value.is_finite() {
119 |                 return Err(crate::Error::invalid_input(format!(
120 |                     "{name} must be finite, got {value}"
121 |                 )));
122 |             }
123 |         }

62 | /// Returns `true` if `data` begins with the cache-entry [`MAGIC`].
63 | ///
64 | /// A cheap prefix check for backends that need to recognize Lance cache
65 | /// entries without fully [`deserialize`](CacheCodec::deserialize)-ing them. A
66 | /// `true` result only means the framing looks like ours; the entry can still
67 | /// decode to a [`Miss`](CacheDecode::Miss) (e.g. wrong `type_id`).
68 | pub fn has_cache_envelope(data: &[u8]) -> bool {
69 |     data.get(..MAGIC.len()) == Some(&MAGIC[..])
70 | }

374 | /// Encode a self-described batch for an exact file version.
375 | pub fn encode_self_described_batch(
376 |     version: ConcreteFileVersion,
377 |     batch: &EncodedBatch,
378 | ) -> Result<Bytes> {
379 |     match version {
380 |         ConcreteFileVersion::V1 => Err(Error::not_supported(
381 |             "Lance v1 does not support self-described current-format batches".to_string(),
382 |         )),
383 |         ConcreteFileVersion::V2_0 => v2_0::encode_self_described_batch(batch),
384 |         ConcreteFileVersion::V2_1 => v2_1::encode_self_described_batch(batch),
385 |         ConcreteFileVersion::V2_2 => v2_2::encode_self_described_batch(batch),
386 |         ConcreteFileVersion::V2_3 => v2_3::encode_self_described_batch(batch),
387 |     }
388 | }

456 |     /// Put the manifest path for a given base_uri and version, should fail if the version **does not** already exist
457 |     async fn put_if_exists(
458 |         &self,
459 |         base_uri: &str,
460 |         version: u64,
461 |         path: &str,
462 |         size: u64,
463 |         _e_tag: Option<String>,
464 |     ) -> Result<()> {
465 |         // Replacing the staging pointer with the canonical path publishes the
466 |         // same generation-independent `(path, size)` tuple from every helper.
467 |         // Each helper still returns the canonical ETag it observed to its caller.
468 |         self.ddb_put()
469 |             .item(base_uri!(), AttributeValue::S(base_uri.into()))
470 |             .item(version!(), AttributeValue::N(version.to_string()))
471 |             .item(path!(), AttributeValue::S(path.to_string()))
472 |             .item(committer!(), AttributeValue::S(self.committer_name.clone()))
473 |             .item("size", AttributeValue::N(size.to_string()))
474 |             .condition_expression(format!(
475 |                 "attribute_exists({}) AND attribute_exists({})",
476 |                 base_uri!(),
477 |                 version!(),
478 |             ))
479 |             .send()
480 |             .await
481 |             .wrap_err()?;
482 | 
483 |         Ok(())
484 |     }
